title: BLE plaintext task admission vector
description: One ordinary Link ingress scenario of the reference firmware. secure_service: whether the firmware registered the secure-session GATT service (ble-secure-session.md section 11.3); identity_visible: pdsh.identity.prove is listed in tools/list; identity_call: proof (completed with a signature), unsupported (UNSUPPORTED 14, no receipt, no signature: the retired tool), or refused (the existing capability refusal of ble-link.md, non-zero, no receipt, no signature).
